lines: You need an AI assistant running on your own devices in the channels you already use.
OpenClaw is an open-source assistant that runs on your own computer and meets you in channels like Discord, Slack, Teams, and Telegram.
It uses a local gateway as a control plane for sessions, tools, events, and channel connections.
Run openclaw onboard --install-daemon to finish setup then check status with openclaw gateway status.
The installer supports macOS, Linux, Windows, and WSL2.
The installer works on macOS, Linux, Windows, or WSL2.
You add tools, skills, and plugins via the Tools, Skills, and Plugins section in the documentation.
The repo is a pnpm workspace. Clone the GitHub link to start development.
OpenClaw Foundation builds this MIT project; Amazon and Red Hat are donors.
On a fresh install, the installer scripts start onboarding automatically.
Send this to someone who needs an AI on their own devices.
Meet OpenClaw, the AI that really does things.
